result:
The motion layer is shipped as v29.60 and passed the gate, including the seed 4242 fingerprint. It covers the title menu, the party window and the arcade board pages, but not the pause or end cards. Motion can't be seen in a still picture, so I took no screenshots. The three new checks measure time instead.

- **Open and close:** a window opens in 240 ms ease-out with a 16 px rise. Items follow 35 ms apart, at most 8. A close takes 140 ms ease-in.
- **Press mid-move:** a close or reopen during a transition starts from the current value, with no jump over 12% per frame. The party window plays an open and close sound.
- **Tab change:** arcade board pages slide in over 200 ms while the old page slides out as a ghost copy.
- **Focus ring:** it eases to its target, with progress checked at 16, 66 and 120 ms. The focused cell grows to 1.05. The ring sits on top of the existing amber outline and trails it briefly.
- **Press feedback:** a confirm press pulses 6% over 120 ms (peak 1.06 at 60 ms). A refused press shakes 6 px over 100 ms.
- **Sound:** a new `uiSndPick` function decides which sound plays.
  - The focus tick has four pitches within ±3% and at most one per 40 ms.
  - Confirm is deeper, back is lighter and shorter, and deny is a low thud.
  - Open and close were left as they were.
  - One focus change logs exactly one tick.

The same checks cover the 0, 50, 100 and 200 ms open and the stagger gaps. They also cover the close and the pulse and shake.

**Not done**
- The 4K frame-time measurement. The gate Chrome only runs at 1888x977.
- Hover (mouse) focus doesn't use the ring.
- No backdrop drift and no glimmer sweep.
- The pause card and end cards. To add a screen, put its selector in `UIM.scope` and add a `UIM.watch` call for it.

The change is logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`. My notes are in `notes/11b-ui-motion.md`. I did not write `notes/ui/motion.md`; that file never existed.

TASK PARTIAL: the motion layer is shipped on the title menu, party window and arcade board with its checks; the 4K frame-time measure, hover ring, backdrop drift and the pause and end cards remain.
